title: Polynomial-time quantum algorithms for the general hidden subgroup problem
formal: Can the hidden subgroup problem over arbitrary finite groups be solved with bounded error using quantum running time polynomial in log of the group order, under the standard efficient group-operation and hiding-function oracle model?
context:
Polynomial query complexity alone is insufficient. The group's representation and permitted operations must be fixed in a full card; the dihedral case is already a separate target.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Would extend one of the central sources of quantum speedups beyond the group families currently understood.
